name: Minase Kyoutarou
source:
Kyoutarou is Takaaki's kohai (underclassman). He is intersted in Takaaki and looks up to him. He is a calm character who is talented at many things, and often attracts attention within the school. But he takes things as they come and doesn't get easily perturbed by things.

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/xasy/xasy.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
